name: motion-caption-components
title_zh: 挑现成动效组件，按字幕提示出编排草稿
tagline_zh: 字幕里已有节拍，别重造轮子。它帮你从 MotionCaption 组件库里挑对的那几个。
tagline_en: Your subtitles already carry the beat. This picks the right MotionCaption parts and assembles a validated.
desc_en: Select existing MotionCaption motion components and produce validated captionforge.agent-draft JSON from subtitle cues. Use for component selection and orchestration, not for creating component code or changing visual styles.
why_zh: 它把「选组件」和「排时序」变成可校验的 JSON 草稿，省去手工对照文档的试错，让编排先于实现跑通。
why_en: Turns component picking and timing into a validated JSON draft, so you can verify the orchestration before any implementation.
limit_zh: 只做组件挑选与编排草稿，不生成组件代码，也不改视觉样式；需要本地已有 MotionCaption 组件库。
limit_en: Selects components and drafts orchestration only — no codegen, no style changes. Requires local MotionCaption library and subtitle-cue input.
title_en: Pick existing motion parts, draft orchestration JSON from.
